svg.title: Installs
svg.desc: Installs of jdx's tools through mise in the 30 days to Oct 7, CI excluded: mr boxington 3,399 (new), hk 62,303 (42% month over month), fnox 42,189 (6% month over month), pitchfork 14,031 (5% month over month), usage 48,812 (-12% month over month), aube 11,025 (-20% month over month). jdx tools combined 9% month over month, all of mise 9%.

g.text: installs through mise · 30d to Oct 7 · CI excluded
jdx tools +9% · all of mise +9% MoM
